coverage: Verified R1 is fitted, nominally 10 kΩ, between /IN and /OUT: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch:1252–1336; inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb:245–374; corroborated by work/netlist/design.xml, components/comp[@ref='R1'] and nets.

Under the condition in inputs/requirements.txt:1, R1 carries 12/10000 = 1.2 mA and dissipates 12²/10000 = 0.0144 W continuously, below the stipulated 0.1 W limit. Reproducible calculation: review-work/circuit/experiments/r1_dc_review.py; results: review-work/circuit/experiments/r1_dc_results.json, calculation.

Inspected work/erc/erc.json and work/drc/drc.json: no reported violations, unconnected items or parity issues. Reviewed execution records and geometry output; these checks do not establish electrical power compliance.
Commands, versions, assumptions, outcomes and locators recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/commands_and_notes.md.
limitations: Evaluation covers only R1 under indefinitely maintained /IN=12 V and /OUT=0 V. Startup, shutdown, reset, brownout, transients, other interfaces and other component ratings were not evaluated.
No physical measurements, temperature prediction, tolerance analysis or manufacturer-specific model; used the native nominal resistance and stipulated continuous power limit.
ERC/DRC were inspected rather than rerun. Their ignored checks remain outside coverage; saved zone fill was not regenerated.
work/geometry/console.log contains PROPERTY_ENUM assertions. Extracted R1 data agree with native sources; geometry output was not treated as electrical validation.
